title: The Workspace Guide: Create Product Videos Step by Step | AIVideosUGC
description: A step-by-step guide to the AIVideosUGC workspace: write a prompt, confirm the quote, track the job, download your video — plus avatars, subtitles, your library, performance and account tools.

guide.h1: The workspace guide, chapter by chapter.
guide.lead: A step-by-step manual for the creation workspace: one chapter per module, numbered steps and real annotated screenshots — so a first-time user can go from an idea to a finished, subtitled ad without leaving the guide.

paths.label: Path A · ~8 min
paths.title: Your first video today
paths.body: From a blank prompt to a rendered, downloadable video — the full core loop.

paths.label: Path B · ~10 min
paths.title: From product link to ad
paths.body: Sellers with a live product page: import, build the product library, generate variations.

paths.label: Path C · ~7 min
paths.title: Polish and deliver
paths.body: You already have a video: track the job, subtitle it, manage your library and account.

concepts.title: Credits & confirmation
concepts.body: Every generation shows its estimated cost before it runs. Confirming holds the credits; a failed job returns them automatically. Nothing is ever charged twice.

concepts.title: Drafts & statuses
concepts.body: A job is a draft until you confirm it, then moves through generating → finishing → completed. Failed jobs show a human-readable reason and always offer a retry.

concepts.title: 15-day retention
concepts.body: Generated videos are kept for 15 days, then automatically deleted. Download anything you want to keep — the guide shows where.

chapters.title: How a generation job runs
chapters.route: Applies to **every tool** · the loop you will repeat the most
chapters.what: Video and image tools all share the same job loop. Understand it once and every chapter after this one is just different inputs. **Estimated cost is always shown before you commit** — you decide with the price on screen.

steps.title: Describe what you want
steps.body: Type a prompt, drop product photos, or paste a product link — depending on the tool. The composer shows an `Optimize` button that rewrites your draft into a structured shooting script.

steps.title: Review the quote
steps.body: The composer footer shows the estimated cost live. When you press generate, a confirmation modal restates the cost and your current balance before anything runs.

steps.title: Confirm — or save as draft
steps.body: `Generate now` holds the credits and starts the job. `Save as draft` keeps everything you entered without spending anything. If generation fails, held credits are returned automatically.

steps.title: Track it in the Library
steps.body: Jobs move through generating → finishing your video → completed. You can leave the page; the badge updates when you come back.

steps.title: Open, download, keep
steps.body: Finished results open in a details modal with `View details` and download links. Generated videos are kept for 15 days — download anything you want to keep.

media.alt: Logged-in Library: filters All videos / In progress / Failed / Completed, a completed job card and the 15-day retention notice
The Confirm generation modal with the estimated cost, balance, and Cancel / Save as draft / Generate now buttons

tip.title: Good to know
tip.body: Guests can build a draft without an account — it is restored the moment you sign in.

chapters.title: Home & the composer
chapters.route: Route **/app/create** · your starting point every time
chapters.what: Home is one composer with **three tabs** — Text to Video, AI Video, AI Image — plus quick-start chips, the tool grid and your recent videos. Anything you start here can be continued from any other module.

steps.title: Pick the right tab
steps.body: **Text to Video** turns a written idea into one finished video. **AI Video** animates the references you attach. **AI Image** generates stills.

steps.title: Write the prompt — or start from a chip
steps.body: The quick-start chips — "Product video ad for your store", "TikTok ad for your brand", "UGC testimonial for your product", "Instagram Reel for your campaign", "Cinematic product reveal", "How-to product video" — prefill the composer with a proven starting prompt.

steps.title: Set type, then Optimize
steps.body: The `Type` selector picks the video family (General product video, UGC review, unboxing…). `Optimize` rewrites your prompt into the structured script the model expects.

steps.title: Model, format, duration, resolution
steps.body: The setting row: model (wan-1080p and friends, with credit cost per duration), aspect ratio (9:16 …), duration (15s …), resolution (1080p). `Generate video` starts the run.

media.alt: Signed-in home: composer with Text to Video / AI Video / AI Image tabs, quick-start chips, tool grid and recent videos

tip.title: Good to know
tip.body: The composer is the same component in every tool module — learn it here and you know it everywhere.

chapters.title: Write it, attach it, send it
chapters.route: Route **/app/create** · the composer, start to submit
chapters.what: There is no multi-step editor to learn: a video starts with **one prompt and your product photos**. This chapter zooms into the composer form and the confirmation step; what happens after you submit is chapter 04.

steps.title: Write the prompt
steps.body: Describe the video you want in plain language — what the product is, what happens on screen, the mood. One clear paragraph is enough; the provider receives your text as the creative direction.

steps.title: Attach product photos
steps.body: Up to four photos, dragged or pasted in. They are sent to the provider as-is — the reference limit is set by what the model supports, not by a fixed template.

steps.title: Type + Optimize
steps.body: The `Type` selector picks the video family (General product video, UGC review, unboxing…). `Optimize` rewrites your prompt into the structured script the model expects.

steps.title: Model, format, duration, resolution
steps.body: The setting row: model (with credit cost per duration), aspect ratio, duration, resolution. The footer shows the estimated cost live before you commit.

steps.title: Confirm — or save as draft
steps.body: `Generate video` opens a confirmation modal: **Confirm generation** restates the estimated cost and your balance. `Generate now` submits and holds the credits; `Save as draft` keeps everything without spending anything. If generation fails, held credits are returned automatically.

media.alt: The composer: prompt, product photos, type selector, settings row and Generate video
The Confirm generation modal: estimated cost 30 credits, balance 1,250 credits, and the Cancel / Save as draft / Generate now buttons

tip.title: Good to know
tip.body: Saving as a draft costs nothing — you only spend credits when you confirm a generation.

chapters.title: Track it & deliver
chapters.what: After you confirm, the server runs the whole job on its own — there are no render steps to babysit. The editor turns into a progress panel, your Library tracks everything, and finished videos are **yours to download for 15 days**.

steps.title: Watch the progress panel
steps.body: Right after you confirm, the editor shows **Creating your video** — "Your prompt and photos are with the video provider. You can leave this page and return from your Library." The status moves from **Generating your video…** to **Finishing your video…**.

steps.title: Leave freely
steps.body: You don't need to keep the page open. The Library badge updates while you work elsewhere — chapter 11 covers the filters.

steps.title: Collect the video
steps.body: When it's done the panel becomes **Your video** — "Your video is ready to download." — with the player, `Download video`, `Create another video` and `Back to progress`. Your Library keeps every finished video for 15 days.

steps.title: If it fails, retry in one click
steps.body: A failed job shows **Let's try that again** with a plain-language reason — `Try again` resubmits the same prompt and photos. Held credits are returned automatically on failure.

media.alt: The Creating your video progress panel: Generating badge, the you-can-leave line, Generating your video… spinner and Back to Library
The finished video panel: Your video, ready to download, with the player, Download video, Create another video and Back to progress

tip.title: Good to know
tip.body: Generated videos are kept for 15 days — download what you want to keep, from the editor or your Library.

chapters.title: AI Video from references
chapters.what: This module is the composer in **AI Video** mode: your references drive the shot. Product photos are the baseline; video and audio references unlock motion and voice on supported models.

steps.title: Attach references
steps.body: 1–4 product photos by drag or paste. On models that support them, reference video and reference audio slots appear — attach a motion clip or a voice sample to steer the result.

steps.title: Type + Optimize
steps.body: Choose the video family and let the optimizer structure your prompt around the references you attached.

steps.title: Quote, confirm, generate
steps.body: The same core loop: estimated cost → confirmation modal → the video lands in your Library.

media.alt: AI Video composer with the reference strip, prompt and settings row

tip.title: Good to know
tip.body: Reference slots depend on the selected model — switch models and the available slots switch with it.

chapters.title: AI Image
chapters.what: Image generation uses tool presets instead of storyboards. Results appear **inline on the page** with download links — they do not enter the video Library.

steps.title: Pick a tool preset
steps.body: Custom image, White background, Change background, Lifestyle photo, Model photo — each preset reshapes the form for its job.

steps.title: Set ratio and references
steps.body: Aspect ratio plus up to four product reference photos. The price line stays honest: `Add a product reference photo to see the price.`

steps.title: Watch the price confirm
steps.body: The line switches to `This generation costs N credits`. If the price changes after you edit inputs, the button asks for a second click — that's the guard, not a bug.

steps.title: Collect the results
steps.body: Queued and running cards show `N credits reserved`; completed cards show Download links right in the grid.

media.alt: AI Image page: preset row, ratio and reference slots with the live price line

chapters.title: URL to Video
chapters.route: Route **/app/create/url-to-video** · paste a link, get a draft
chapters.what: The fastest entry path for sellers: paste a live product URL and the importer reads the page for you. You confirm what it found, pick the hero photo, and land in a prefilled video draft.

steps.title: Paste the product URL
steps.body: Any public HTTPS product page. Blocked or unsupported pages return a specific reason — not a generic error.

steps.title: Review the scrape preview
steps.body: The importer shows the sourced title, description, detected images and a possible price — each with a confidence label, so you know what to trust.

steps.title: Pick the photo and import
steps.body: Choose the hero image and confirm. The import is saved into your product history.

steps.title: Continue to the video draft
steps.body: One click opens the product-demo scene form with the photo and brief already filled in.

media.alt: URL to Video importer: URL field, Import button and how-it-works copy

tip.title: Good to know
tip.body: "Possible price" is read from the page and always marked unconfirmed — the video never quotes a price you didn't approve.

chapters.title: Product Links — your product library
chapters.what: Everything you import lives in **your product library** with its photo, description and source. Generate again whenever you need a new variation — the page even builds videos inline without leaving.

steps.title: Import products
steps.body: Same importer as chapter 07. Each import becomes a library entry with thumbnail, description and source host.

steps.title: Manage the library
steps.body: Click an entry to backfill anything the scrape missed; delete entries you no longer need.

steps.title: Create a video inline
steps.body: The "Create your video" panel embeds the scene form right on the page. A live run banner tracks progress: "Generating your video" → "Your video is ready" with Download and Open Library.

media.alt: Product Links page with the import call to action

chapters.title: AI Avatar studio
chapters.route: Route **/app/create/ai-actors** · a presenter for your product stories
chapters.what: Pick a presenter (or upload your own portrait), attach the product, write the script, and the studio produces a talking-head product video. Every presenter card carries a voice profile and a sample line with audio — listen before you commit.

steps.title: Attach product references
steps.body: Drag or paste the product photos the presenter will hold, wear or demonstrate.

steps.title: Choose a presenter
steps.body: **Available avatars · 53**, filtered All / Women / Men with search by name, character or scene. Each card previews the voice and shows a sample line; `Use this presenter` casts them. **My avatars** lets you upload your own portrait.

steps.title: Write the script
steps.body: Talking points or a full script (up to 5,000 characters), then set format, duration and spoken language.

steps.title: Quote, confirm, generate
steps.body: The confirm modal shows estimated cost against balance — same core loop as every tool.

media.alt: The presenter picker dialog: 53 avatars, gender filters with counts, search, cards with voice traits, sample quotes and audio players, Use this presenter
Browsing the presenter grid and auditioning a voice sample

chapters.title: Subtitle Studio
chapters.what: Subtitle Studio works on **finished** videos. Each operation creates a new version of the video — the original is never overwritten — and long jobs keep running while you work elsewhere in the workspace.

steps.title: Pick a finished video
steps.body: The left list shows completed videos only — search by prompt or title, page through your history.

steps.title: Choose an operation
steps.body: **Generate subtitles** — smart captions from the actual speech. **Promo lines** — burn short promotional lines into a new version. **Product copy** — turn product copy into on-screen text. The last two accept your own text, one line per screen.

steps.title: Style it with live preview
steps.body: STYLE Auto / Classic / Bold / Minimal · SIZE Small / Medium / Large · POSITION Bottom / Middle / Top · COLOUR White / Yellow / Cyan / Black · BACKDROP Auto / None / Box / Outline — the **sample caption preview** updates as you click.

steps.title: Generate a new version
steps.body: The job runs server-side; a pill elsewhere in the workspace tells you it's still going. Versions stack as tabs over the player — V2 · With subtitles, V1 · With subtitles…

media.alt: The three-column Subtitle Studio: source list, operations, style chips with preview stage and version tabs
Clicking style chips while the sample caption preview updates live
A real vertical UGC clip loaded in Subtitle Studio — the style chips act on real footage, not placeholders.
media.caption: Real example · a vertical UGC clip, ready for subtitle styling.

tip.title: Good to know
tip.body: Submit a long batch of subtitle jobs first — the pill keeps you informed while you generate your next video elsewhere.

chapters.title: Library
chapters.what: The Library is the single source of truth for video jobs: filters, the details modal, retries and the 15-day retention clock. If a result exists, it lives here.

steps.title: Filter the list
steps.body: **All videos / In progress / Failed / Completed**, with infinite scroll and a reference-reel strip of the images your jobs used. The filter row is captured in chapter 01.

steps.title: Open the details modal
steps.body: `View details` on any card opens the result video, per-shot clips, description, every reference you attached and the exact submitted parameters — duration, aspect, resolution, refs.

steps.title: Fix a failure the right way
steps.body: **Retry render** re-runs assembly when the clips are fine (failed render, finished clips). **Regenerate** prefills the composer from the job for a fresh attempt. Failed jobs explain themselves in plain language.

steps.title: Delete deliberately
steps.body: Delete asks for confirmation and uses a revision check, so two open tabs can't delete the same job twice. Everything auto-expires after 15 days.

media.alt: The Library details modal open on a completed job with the player, clips and submitted parameters
A real clip sitting in the library grid — every thumbnail opens the full video.
media.caption: Real example · clips like this live in your library grid.

chapters.title: Assistant, extras & your account
chapters.route: Routes **/app/create** (assistant) · **Inspirations**, **Performance**, **Teams & Brands**, **Developer access** in the workspace sidebar · **/account**
chapters.what: The supporting cast: an assistant for scripts and shot ideas, an inspiration gallery that hands its cards straight into your composer, the tools that turn finished videos into decisions — performance, teams, and API access — and the account page where credits and receipts live.

steps.title: Brief the assistant
steps.body: Suggestion chips start the conversation — a 15-second product video script, three shot ideas, a UGC-style voiceover, a stronger first three seconds. Replies stream as you read. It advises; it doesn't generate.

steps.title: Borrow from Inspirations
steps.body: Filter the gallery by video or photo idea, search by category, and open a card that catches your eye. The detail dialog hands the setup straight into your workspace with `Create a video like this` or `Create an image like this`.

steps.title: Compare your ad results
steps.body: **Performance** imports your advertising results and lines them up by period: a performance overview plus a breakdown by creative, so you can see which video actually drove results before you make the next one.

steps.title: Manage teams & brands
steps.body: **Teams & Brands** is where workspace access, brand details and product information you have reviewed live — the shared facts every teammate's videos build on.

steps.title: Connect with the API
steps.body: **Developer access** issues API keys and webhook endpoints. Keys carry scopes; task creation asks for a unique `Idempotency-Key` header so a retry refers to the same operation.

steps.title: Watch your credits
steps.body: The toolbar chip shows your balance and refreshes after every paid operation. The account page holds credits, purchases and receipts.

steps.title: Get help
steps.body: Support opens a dialog with a four-step getting-started guide ("Create a product video in four steps") and a Book-a-Call path to a human.

media.alt: The embedded Inspirations gallery: filter tabs, a category wall, and the detail dialog for a linen-shirt showcase with Create a video like this

tip.title: Heads-up
tip.body: Two sidebar items are marked **Simulation** — AI Twin and Ad Clone. They let you try the workflows on sample data; neither produces a real video today.
